The diff is clean, the syntax compiles, and the fix is minimal and addresses the logical flaw in boundary handling of `_split_cells`.

I will now submit the patch.
The patch was successfully submitted. I will now provide the final summary.

The issue in `Segment._split_cells` was caused by complex and flawed logic when handling variable-width characters near the split boundary, particularly when the cell count exceeded the requested `cut`. I replaced the original iterative logic with a clean loop that iterates through the text, accumulating cell widths until the next character would exceed the `cut` limit. This ensures the first segment is correctly truncated at the last valid character boundary, resolving the split cell issue.
